introHtml: Recycled health products let you promote wellness and environmental responsibility at the same time. From RPET boonie hats and recycled pill cases to eco-friendly sunglasses and cooling towels, these items are made from post-consumer materials. They work well for safety managers equipping outdoor teams, HR directors launching wellness challenges, or marketing directors seeking sustainable trade show giveaways. Each product can be decorated with your logo using screen printing or embroidery.
